notes: No duty rota and no confirmed animal poison line found (Ramathibodi Poison Center hotline 1367 is 24/7 but its page does not mention animals; a 10-year animal-poisoning study from it exists but its page could not be read). Follow-up 2026-11-10 added Phyathai 7 (2), Happy Pet (2), PIPC HQ, Mahidol Prasu-Arthorn, Chotana. Still not added because only aggregators were available or the official page could not be opened (provenance block / robots / redirect): Don Kaew Animal Hospital Chiang Mai (097-957-2519, 24 h per thailandnomads), Chiang Mai University small animal hospital (+66 53 948 031; vet.cmu.ac.th only redirects to vmcmu.vet.cmu.ac.th, which could not be opened; cmu.ac.th article has no hospital contact) and CMU local animal hospital (emergency 24 h tel. 053-037071 per cmhy.city), Tongkaew Animal Hospital Chiang Mai, San Sai Animal Hospital (053-397884, pet-variety list only), RTB Animal Hospital Phuket (076 213 464, rtbcenter.com not opened), Aura Pets Phuket (065 141 6964, aurapetswellness.com not opened), Dr Film Animal Clinic Hat Yai, Metta Animal Hospital Hat Yai, Setthakit Animal Hospital Hat Yai (robots.txt disallowed), PSU hospital pages (vet.psu.ac.th/hospital/?p=84 and agency page: only faculty phones 074-289600/-608, no hours or 24 h wording opened), Bangkok Pet Hospital, Pet Avenue, Ari Pet Hospital. Koh Samui (Animalia Pet Hospital, Samui Animal Clinic: only aggregators and Facebook), Hua Hin (Kasetsart Hua Hin page opened but gives only the Bang Khen faculty address/phone; Pet Time, Tan-diau only Facebook) and Krabi (Krabi Veterinary Clinic only Facebook): no usable official source found. Mahidol hospital has no hours/24 h wording on any opened page.
